title: Let a detached focused launcher run on Windows be stopped through the supported stop path
outcome: Let a detached focused launcher run on Windows be stopped through the supported stop path
acceptance: A `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --detach --input commit -- …` run on Windows records a stoppable owned supervisor (the same Windows job protocol full runs use), and the launcher's supported stop request ends its whole process tree, leaving a terminal stopped result with the source-identity records intact

A behaviour test on Windows starts a detached focused run of a long command, requests stop, and checks the run reaches a terminal stopped state with no surviving child process; non-detached runs and POSIX behaviour are unchanged
